preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of nodes N in the tree must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(S) == N and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must have length N and consist only of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N and U != V for U, V in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must involve two distinct nodes within the range 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output for each query must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in DIS(V, LCA(U, V)))
postconditions.description: The string DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) must contain at least one lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: any(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in DIS(U, LCA(U, V)))
postconditions.description: The string DIS(U, LCA(U, V)) must contain at least one lowercase English letter.
